title: Protocol Decision
description: One decision emitted by a protocol (or by one reviewer inside a specialised-reviewer protocol, before aggregation) for a given replay step.

step.description: Matches the replay timestep this decision responds to.

reviewer_id.description: Set when this decision comes from one reviewer/monitor inside a multi-reviewer protocol, before aggregation. Null for single-monitor protocols or the final aggregated decision.

signals_detected.description: Discrete evidence/signals the reviewer flagged, independent of its final decision -- lets analysis compare what was noticed, not only what was decided.
